Best for start-ups and agencies wanting a free/cheap CRM with API, webhooks and MCP on every plan.

## Rate limits

REST: 100 requests/second for reads and 25/second for writes across the whole API; MCP tool calls have their own per-workspace limits by tier; 429 with a Retry-After date (usually the next second).

More on limitsLess

Lower per-endpoint limits: SQL 2/s, merge records 5/s, call recordings 1/s, List notes temporarily 10/s (since 2026-09-02). List records and List entries also have score-based limits (per-query complexity score plus a 10-second sliding-window total across all apps and tokens). Every referenced record created inline via target\_record\_reference counts as one more write. Webhook delivery is capped at 25 requests/second per target URL. MCP tool calls use per-workspace tiers: Read 100/s, Write 25/s, Merge 5/s, Search 300/minute, Semantic search 2/s, Reporting 2/s, SQL 2/s. Our hands-on calls saw no X-RateLimit-\* headers on successful responses.

## How to get an API key

Attio uses API key. The steps below follow Attio's own docs.

1.  Create a Attio account. The Free plan includes API access.
2.  Single workspace: generate an API key in the developer settings of your app (always workspace-level, scopes set at creation, key does not expire per our /v2/self test); multi-workspace apps: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (workspace- or user-level tokens; user-level requires PKCE)
3.  Send it with every request: header: Authorization: Bearer <token> (HTTP Basic also accepted: token as username, blank password; Bearer recommended).
4.  Make a first call: Upsert a record by a unique attribute (e.g. domains, email\_addresses). Keep the key in an environment variable, never in the command.
    
    ```
    curl -X PUT "https://api.attio.com/v2/objects/{object}/records?matching_attribute={attribute}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATTIO_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{}'
    ```

## Strengths and limits

### Where it fits

-   Start-ups and agencies wanting a free/cheap CRM with API, webhooks and MCP on every plan
-   Idempotent writes: PUT upsert with matching\_attribute (domains for companies, email\_addresses for people)
-   Custom objects and lists modelled as relational records
-   Agent access via the hosted MCP at `https://mcp.attio.com/mcp`

### Where it falls short

-   Bulk loads at speed: no batch record endpoint in the OpenAPI spec, writes capped at 25/second
-   Teams needing custom objects without paying for Pro (Free and Plus: no custom objects; Free up to 3 objects, Plus up to 5)
-   Data sourcing (Attio enriches records it holds, it is not a prospect database)

### Worth knowing

-   Create endpoints throw on unique-attribute conflicts (domains, email\_addresses); use the PUT upsert with matching\_attribute instead. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/companies/upsert-a-company-record](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/companies/upsert-a-company-record)
-   The write limit counts every record created implicitly: one person plus two referenced companies costs 3 of the 25 writes/second. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/rate-limiting](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/rate-limiting)
-   Attio may lower rate limits during incident response; always handle 429 even at low volume. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/rate-limiting](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/guides/rate-limiting)
-   SQL endpoint is Enterprise-only and capped at 2 requests/second. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/sql/query-sql](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/sql/query-sql)
-   Activities and activity-record endpoints (2026-10-14) and meeting link updates are beta. Source: [docs.attio.com/changelog/rest-api](https://docs.attio.com/changelog/rest-api)

8 moreShow fewer

-   Merging two records creates a NEW record id; both originals become unreadable. Re-find the survivor by its natural key (domain/email), never by a pre-merge id. Large merges return 202 and reads 404 (merge\_in\_progress) until done. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/records/merge-two-records](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/records/merge-two-records)
-   Search records (POST /v2/objects/records/search) is eventually consistent; do not search-after-create in a loop, use records/query for up-to-date results. Source: [api.attio.com/openapi/api](https://api.attio.com/openapi/api)
-   Domain values are validated: a filter or write with an invalid TLD (e.g..example) returns 400 'Invalid domain value'.
-   Successful responses carry no X-RateLimit-\* headers, so budget the 100/25 per-second limits client-side.
-   Spec server is `https://api.attio.com` with /v2 in every path; this record keeps /v2 in base\_url and omits it from paths (not doubled). Source: [api.attio.com/openapi/api](https://api.attio.com/openapi/api)
-   Prices are USD per user per month (monthly vs annual billing; annual saves 20%). The pricing page's own price data also carries EUR/GBP; only the USD values are used here. The SQL endpoint and the query-particle-sql MCP tool are Enterprise only. Source: [attio.com/pricing](https://attio.com/pricing)
-   MCP auth is OAuth only (log in as your Attio user, no API key); it is listed in the Claude and ChatGPT connector directories. Source: [docs.attio.com/mcp/overview](https://docs.attio.com/mcp/overview)
-   Integrations: Clay and Zapier are confirmed on attio.com/apps; n8n and Make were not confirmed from a vendor page on 2026-10-25 (n8n.io/integrations/attio 404, make.com behind a bot wall), so they are not listed. Source: [attio.com/apps/clay](https://attio.com/apps/clay); [attio.com/apps/zapier](https://attio.com/apps/zapier)

### Our take

We compared free CRMs for our own team and Attio Free came out as our first choice: at $0 it includes 3 seats, 50,000 records, the API, webhooks, workflows and an official hosted MCP. The deciding point was deduplication in the API itself: companies are unique on domain and people on email, so a repeated upsert updates the record that already exists.

## Who should use it

Use Attio for

Start-ups and agencies wanting a free/cheap CRM with API, webhooks and MCP on every plan

Look elsewhere for

Bulk loads at speed: no batch record endpoint in the OpenAPI spec, writes capped at 25/second

## Before you build

Four things to settle first, each read off Attio's own pages.

-   **Confirm the API is on your plan**The Free plan includes API access. Free tier: Free $0, up to 3 seats, 50,000 records, up to 3 objects (no custom objects), 100 seat credits/user + 250 workspace credits per month.
    
-   **Keep the key out of your code**API key. It is sent as: header: Authorization: Bearer <token> (HTTP Basic also accepted: token as username, blank password; Bearer recommended).
    
-   **Design around the rate limit**REST: 100 requests/second for reads and 25/second for writes across the whole API; MCP tool calls have their own per-workspace limits by tier; 429 with a Retry-After date (usually the next second).
    
-   **Know the catch before you scale**Create endpoints throw on unique-attribute conflicts (domains, email\_addresses); use the PUT upsert with matching\_attribute instead. Source: [docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/companies/upsert-a-company-record](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/endpoint-reference/companies/upsert-a-company-record)
